source: Auraicept na n-Éces; kennings are Bríatharogam Morainn mac Moín per McManus, Ériu 39 (1988)
note: Modern scholarship holds that at most eight letter-names are truly trees; the Auraicept's tree glosses are medieval. Tree names above follow the Auraicept glosses with the literal name-meanings in parentheses. Divinatory meanings are modern synthesis.

staves.name: Beith
staves.meaning: The birch — first tree of spring, white-barked and cleansing. Beginnings; purification; the first step taken lightly.

staves.name: Luis
staves.meaning: Luis the flame — lustre of the eye. Vision and protection; the rowan's berries bright against trouble. See clearly, and be warded.

staves.name: Fearn
staves.meaning: The alder — vanguard of warriors, wood of shields. Courage at the front; stand in the shield-wall for what matters.

staves.name: Sail
staves.meaning: The willow — pallor of the lifeless, sustenance of bees. Dreams, grief, the moon's tide in the blood. Honor the sorrow; it is honey's beginning.

staves.name: Nion
staves.meaning: The forked branch — establishing of peace. Weaving together what was split; the ash spear-shaft turned to the loom. Make peace.

staves.name: Úath
staves.meaning: The hawthorn hedge — fear itself, the hounds gathering. A thorny trial; fear is the hedge, not the field. Go through, not around.

staves.name: Dair
staves.meaning: The oak — highest tree, king of the grove. Strength, endurance, rightful authority. Stand like the oak: deep-rooted, unhurried.

staves.name: Tinne
staves.kenning: one of three parts of a wheel
staves.meaning: The iron bar — one of three parts of a wheel. Craft and structure; the holly's part in the chariot. Build it to last.

staves.name: Coll
staves.meaning: The hazel — fairest tree, friend of nutshells. Wisdom; the nuts of knowledge dropping into the well. Inspiration is near — catch it.

staves.name: Ceirt
staves.meaning: The apple-bush — shelter even for the wild and wandering. Choice; beauty; the otherworld's orchard gate. Choose the beautiful thing.

staves.name: Muin
staves.meaning: The vine — strongest in exertion, whether by neck, ruse, or love. Effort with strategy; love's labor that climbs. Work cleverly.

staves.name: Gort
staves.meaning: The ivy-field — sweetest grass, sating of multitudes. Tenacious growth that covers all. Persist; the green tide wins.

staves.name: Ngetal
staves.meaning: The broom — sustenance of the leech, raiment of physicians. Healing by clearing; the physician's broom sweeps clean. Clear it out.

staves.name: Straif
staves.meaning: The blackthorn — strongest reddening, sulphur's dye. Transformation; the red work of alchemy. Something must burn to change color.

staves.name: Ruis
staves.meaning: The elder — most intense blushing, glow of anger. Threshold and ending; the red door between worlds. An ending stands open — walk through.

staves.name: Ailm
staves.meaning: The pine — loudest groan, beginning of calling. Clarity; the high clear note. See from the height; call it plainly.

staves.name: Onn
staves.meaning: The furze — wounder of horses, smoothest of craft. Movement; the journey that wounds and teaches. Keep moving; the wound is tuition.

staves.name: Ur
staves.meaning: The heather-earth — in cold dwellings, propagation of plants. Grounding; home, even a cold one. Tend the hearth you have.

staves.name: Eadhadh
staves.meaning: The aspen — the discerning tree, brother of birch. Discernment; the leaf that trembles at every wind. Listen to the trembling — it knows.

staves.name: Idhadh
staves.meaning: The yew — oldest tree, fairest of the ancients. Age; memory; the long watch. What is old here is wise — consult it.

staves.name: Eabhadh
staves.meaning: The fair-swimming one — first of the forfeda, the later signs. Mystery; crossing dark water. What comes next is not yet named.

staves.name: Ór
staves.meaning: Gold — most venerable substance, splendour of form. Worth; true value recognized. What glitters here is actually gold.

staves.name: Uilleann
staves.meaning: The honeysuckle — fragrant tree, great elbow. Desire; sweet attraction that binds. What draws you is sweet — check the binding.

staves.name: Ifin
staves.meaning: The gooseberry — sweetest tree, most wonderful taste. Harvest; sweetness guarded by thorns. The gift is real; mind the thorns.

staves.name: Phagos
staves.meaning: The beech — twin of hazel, the sick one's groan turning to learning. Healing through knowledge; the book opens. Study it out.
